method: OpenStreetMap way 35204808 (name 2875) used verbatim. CERN's MapCERN Facilities layer names building 2875 "SR8" (surface building at LHC Point 8); the OSM polygon centroid is within 1 m of the official one. The CAST site record places the experiment at SR8 (its cryogenic coldbox is labelled "/SR8" under "CERN Axion Solar Telescope (CAST) - LHC Point 8", src:axions-cast-sr8-point8-cryo-doc, a secondary CERN cryogenics document); no official CAST page found names the building, so the identification of CAST with this building rests on that document and the name SR8.
name: SR8 building (building 2875), LHC Point 8: CAST site

summary.plain: The big surface building SR8 at LHC Point 8, which the CERN Axion Solar Telescope (CAST) records place the experiment in.
